purpose: Qualify coaster candidates against existing hidden Park and ParkItem records; no site integration, no publication and no integration date asserted.

entries.finding: Official site lists Bobbahn alongside climbing garden, downhill carts, bungee and winter activities. Hidden Park already has Bob-Bahn as ParkItem.
entries.decision: InsidePark; integrate existing Park and ParkItem.

entries.decision: InsidePark; integrate existing Park and ParkItem.

entries.finding: Official summer activities page presents GoldRunner Coaster within Epic Discovery alongside Alpine Slide and other activities. Hidden Park already has Gold Runner as ParkItem. Exact Wikimedia photo is CC BY 3.0 by DReifGalaxyM31 and shows the coaster.
